root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `Conf.getRuntimeConfigure().isForceInterpreter()` must be true before `Loader.parseModule(Span<const uint8_t>(Data, Size))`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `FuzzTool()` may parse attacker-controlled bytes, it must enable interpreter mode with `Conf.getRuntimeConfigure().setForceInterpreter(true)` so embedded `wasmedge` AOT sections cannot switch the loader onto the AOT-only path.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `force_interpreter_enabled=0` at `fuzztool_config` and still reaches `parse_returned`, violating the missing configuration obligation at parse entry. The fixed original records `force_interpreter_enabled=1` at the same source event and genuinely reaches `parse_returned` on the original PoC, satisfying the root obligation without perturbation.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: vulnerable original: fuzztool_config.force_interpreter_enabled=0 with parse_returned present; fixed original: fuzztool_config.force_interpreter_enabled=1 with parse_returned present.

nodes.state: `loadSegment()` takes the AOT skip branch and leaves `CodeSeg.getExpr().getInstrs().size() == 0` instead of loading the function body.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records skip_body_state.wasm_type_current=1 and skip_body_state.expr_instr_count_after=0.

nodes.state: After `compile(Code.getExpr().getInstrs())` returns, the AOT function compiler still has `Stack.size() == 0`; no value was pushed before `compileReturn()`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records compile_post_expr.expr_instr_count=0 and compile_post_expr.stack_size_after_compile=0.

nodes.state: At `stackPop()`, `Stack.back()` executes while `Stack.size() == 0`, so the sink reads from the empty internal value stack.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records stackpop_sink.stack_size_before_back=0.

edges.relation: The same `ForceInterpreter` state chosen in `FuzzTool()` is still false when `loadModule()` handles the attacker-provided `wasmedge` custom section, so the parser remains on the AOT-capable path.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records fuzztool_config.force_interpreter_enabled == aot_section_state.force_interpreter_enabled == 0.

edges.relation: The `WASMType` value set to `InputType::UniversalWASM` by the custom section is the same `WASMType` later checked by `loadSegment()`, enabling the skip-body branch that avoids `loadExpression()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records aot_section_state.wasm_type_after == skip_body_state.wasm_type_current == 1.

edges.relation: The empty code expression left by the skip branch is the same empty instruction sequence passed into `FunctionCompiler::compile(...)`, so no wasm instruction can push a return value before `compileReturn()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records skip_body_state.expr_instr_count_after == compile_post_expr.expr_instr_count == 0.

edges.relation: The same zero `Stack.size()` left after compiling the empty expression is still present when `stackPop()` executes `Stack.back()`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records compile_post_expr.stack_size_after_compile == stackpop_sink.stack_size_before_back == 0.
